name: Piotr Müller - § 65 - Am 36
title: REPORT on public procurement
part_text: Ea. whereas adequate protection for employers’ organisations and trade unions against any acts of interference by each other or each other’s agents or members in their establishment, functioning or administration should be ensured in full respect of International Labour Organization (ILO) Conventions No 87 (1948)1a and No 98 (1949)1b; \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_ 1a ILO Convention No 87 of 1948 on the Freedom of Association and the Protection of the Right to Organise. . 1b ILO Convention No 98 of 1949 on the Right to Organise and Collective Bargaining.
